STRATEGY: Parent cooperates when opponent cooperation rate is high, retaliates on defection, forgives if rate >=0.55 and recent D <=1, and occasionally defects at n%17==0. Proposed change: add forgiveness after a mutual defection streak to recover against four_D_TFT, and defect on the last round.
